title: ResPyre: PARH-OSSM framework for camera-derived respiratory motion
description: Paper-submission release of ResPyre, including the PARH-OSSM implementation, fixed camera-motion observation operators, paper-facing evaluation scripts, figure/table generation scripts, and verification audits used for the physiology-aligned state-space decomposition study of camera-derived respiratory motion. Raw third-party video and physiology datasets are not redistributed.
